card.name: Linking words inside warning clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, its, is, but, the) in the middle of a clause in a warning section, such as 'variable in its presentation' or 'tapered ... but with recognition'. Also fires on 'include' in a template tag.

modes.label: Linking words in warnings
modes.description: Short words like in, its, but, the, is partway through a drug-label caution sentence, just before the clause continues.
modes.example: Because this disorder is variable<< in>> its expression, other organ systems not noted
